about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm a junior full-stack developer focused on the React ecosystem and Node.js backends. From pixel-perfect interfaces to well-designed APIs, I enjoy every step of building a product.
I like to understand the problem before writing code, and I care about maintainability and clear communication. I'm now looking for a team where I can keep growing and take real ownership.

items.name: ShopStack
items.description: A full-stack e-commerce demo: product catalog, shopping cart, order management and JWT auth, with the frontend and backend deployed separately.

items.name: TaskFlow
items.description: A task management app with a drag-and-drop kanban board: create projects, assign tasks, set due dates and track progress.

items.name: DataBoard
items.description: A dashboard that visualizes public API data, with switchable charts, response caching and a dark mode.
Built pages for an internal admin dashboard, integrated APIs and designed several backend endpoints.
Built marketing sites and an online booking system for local small businesses — from requirements gathering to deployment.
